title: IceMC
description: IceMC is a Minecraft: Java Edition server focused on PvP and SMP gameplay with custom progression systems, crates, and daily rewards.
body:
IceMC is a Minecraft: Java Edition server focused on competitive PvP and Survival (SMP) gameplay with a lightweight, progression-based experience.

We aim to provide a balanced and enjoyable environment where players can grind, compete, and progress through custom systems without pay-to-win advantages.

🔹 Features
PvP-focused gameplay with balanced mechanics
Survival (SMP) world with progression systems
Custom crates and rewards system
Shards and in-game economy features
Daily rewards for active players
Community-driven development
🔹 Community

IceMC is built around an active and growing community. We value fair play, consistency, and continuous improvement based on player feedback.

🌐 Server Info
IP: icemc.online
Discord: https://discord.gg/bymeJ4XZgj
Version: Minecraft Java 1.20–1.21+ (compatible range depending on setup)
